artifacts.summary: Attributes the full 3,294 B eager-context growth since the last reviewed 2026-10-18 measurement to six specific files (sapience extension's entirely-new EXTENSION.md, core/lean/literature/memory/nix additions), finds no redistributable duplication in any of them, and recommends a route (b) reviewed/dated baseline move rather than a trim-and-relocate.

memory_candidates.content: measure-eager-context.sh's 'claudemd' channel = core/templates/claudemd-header.md (prepended untrimmed) + each ACTIVE extension's own merge_targets.claudemd.source file (from its manifest.json), trailing-whitespace-trimmed per fragment. Active-extension set comes from .claude-extensions.json's top-level 'extensions' keys, not from scanning agent-system/extensions/*. To attribute an eager-budget regression, diff this per-extension file list against the last reviewed measurement commit (found via 'git log -- .../orchestrator-context-budget.json') rather than guessing from aggregate totals -- a brand-new extension (0 B at baseline) contributes its entire EXTENSION.md as pure growth, distinct from an existing extension's incremental edit.
